invariants: signup alone does not imply a monetary reward
reward policy changes are versioned and never rewrite historical grants
profile switching cannot create additional referral identities
marketing referral cannot grant operational profile authority
launchRule: Initial pilot rewards are Owner-approved OFF. Any future reward requires a new explicit Owner-approved qualification rule, benefit type/value, caps, territory applicability, accounting/tax treatment and evidence-retention rule before activation.

ownerDecision.rationale: Measure organic referral behavior first and avoid unapproved reward fraud/accounting/tax/payout complexity.
